strategyReview: The standout is weekend HL funding reversion long: clean live trades are 271/391 (69%) with average +0.36% and shadows are 188/253 with average +0.99%; one-touch NO sell-YES edge and manual PM-IV rich-NO are also small but positive. The main damage is coming from shadow-mined spot-prediction families and Polymarket proxy shorts: gold cap/no-bias tail shorts are 0% on scorable tests, CBRS/AAPL fixed-threshold funding reversions whipsaw near post-normalization states, BTC cross-asset/listed-IV momentum confirmations are late/coincident, and PM proxy short clusters are leaking because they translate a pricing premium into a spot move without sufficient alignment or liquidity discipline.

failureClusters.theme: Gold tail-rich spot-short signals are inverted
failureClusters.evidence: shadow_one_touch_high_edge_no_gold_heatmap_no is 0/20 and shadow_no_bias_adjusted_gap_shadow_gold_short_rich_tail_no is 0/11. Aug 4 and Aug 5 showed GOLD +5.37% and +3.97% after cap-edge triggers. The cap/gap edge reflects structural contract richness, not an impending spot decline.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop using GOLD underlying-cap/no-bias edge as a bearish spot trigger. Keep these families in shadow and, if anything, fade the contract premium with explicit edge/spread filters rather than forecasting spot direction.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS < -10 (H-539) is 45% wins and AAPL < -10 (H-537) is 53% wins. Losses cluster when funding has already normalized to +5.5%/+10.4% or when it extends further to -67%/-162%. The flat threshold fires on non-tail states.
failureClusters.recommendation: Refine to true weekend timing plus a distributional tail condition such as 7-day percentile/z-score, not a single fixed funding level. Refinements proposed for H-539 and H-537.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 6/16 (38%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 3/12 (25%). Wins are concentrated on one Aug 2 sample; HYPE spot/OI and rising listed IV are mostly coincident or late rather than predictive.
failureClusters.recommendation: Avoid chasing already-extended BTC when HYPE or rising IV merely confirms. Refine to momentum-pause entries or replace HYPE confirmation with BTC PM IV compression.

failureClusters.theme: Polymarket proxy shorts leak in wide markets
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/19 (16%), PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/14 (7%), RELATIVE_VALUE_HEATMAP is 4/15 (27%), and OPT_IV_GT_PM_IV_DOWNSIDE is 2/16 (13%). A recent GOLD proxy short lost -7.02% with wide_pm_spread and sourceComparison=opposite_direction.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep PM proxy shorts shadow-gated. Require tight spreads, direction alignment with the source signal, and enough sell-YES edge before any promotion; do not allow source disagreement to pass as confirmation.

newHypotheses.description: Short GOLD when GLD put/call ratio is in the bottom 10% of its 7-day range AND spot remains above its 24h SMA, matching the FIND-0053 shadow cluster where the positive-trend block was short. This is a fade of call crowding in a still-uptrending tape.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot/perp declines at least 2% within 2 days after the extreme call-crowding signal.

newHypotheses.description: Sell YES on rich PM-IV upside touch contracts expiring within 30 days, when PM IV is at least 10 vol points above listed option IV and there is at least 3 points of sell-YES edge. This is the near-expiry, above-strike richness cluster from FIND-0024.
newHypotheses.prediction: The sold YES side of scoped one-touch contracts loses value over the holding period; spot/perp stays below the upside barrier and the position profits from premium decay.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: only go long CBRS on weekend days when CBRS funding is in the bottom 10% of its 7-day distribution. This fixes the failing trigger that also fired after funding had already normalized to +5.5% or was in a non-extreme state.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp rises at least 2% within 2 days as deeply negative weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: only go long AAPL on weekend days when AAPL funding is in the bottom 10% of its 7-day distribution, instead of a flat < -10% that caught post-normalization states around +5.5% and +10.4%.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot/perp rises at least 2% within 2 days as deeply negative weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: replace HYPE spot/OI cross-asset confirmation with BTC PM IV compression. This tests the same trend continuation without relying on the coincident HYPE risk-on signal that failed out-of-sample.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot/perp rises at least 2% within 7 days when trend strength coexists with compressed PM IV.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-170: buy BTC on a modest 24h pullback rather than after a 24h gain, while keeping the 24h SMA/7d high context and rising listed IV confirmation. This addresses the extension-chasing mechanism behind the 25% win rate.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot/perp rises at least 2% within 7 days from a momentum pause within a still-intact uptrend and rising options IV.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The mined cap-edge condition fired repeatedly but GOLD spot failed to decline, including +5.37% and +3.97% moves. The cap-edge points are a structural richness/structural cap signal, not spot-direction evidence, so the premise that the YES price is too high because it reflects excessive bullish demand is not supported.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: All 11 scorable tests lost, with GOLD generally rising between 0.25% and 2.62%. The no-bias large gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts did not indicate an imminent downside reversal; it was persistent contract richness rather than a spot-top signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The < -10 threshold fired on both true extreme and partially normalized funding states. Losses show entries after funding had already moved to +5.5% and then collapsed to -67%, or funding continuing to -162%; the signal was too broad and not actually isolating weekend tail overshoots.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: CBRS funding below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days leading to a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL showed the same off-side trigger problem: losses cluster when funding is already +5.5% or +10.4%, not deeply negative. The flat < -10% condition captures early normalization or non-extreme states rather than true tail reversion setups.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day rapidly normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE confirmation condition added no predictive value beyond the initial Aug 2 sample; later tests mostly missed. HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI is a coincident risk-on reading, not a reliable BTC continuation signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI confirms a >2% BTC long move over 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Long BTC after spot is already above the 24h SMA, near the 7d high, and up more than 0.75% in 24 hours enters near short-term extension. Rising options IV then behaves as a late confirmation or premium signal rather than a predictor of follow-through.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV leads to further >2% BTC gains within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that rich PM contract edges are not automatically spot-directional signals: GOLD cap/no-bias tail shorts all failed because the richness persisted while spot rallied. Fixed funding thresholds were too loose and fired after normalization; refinements now require weekend timing plus a 7-day funding percentile tail. BTC momentum confirmations are also late: HYPE and listed-IV confirmations chased extension, so refinements replace HYPE with BTC PM IV compression and shift the IV-momentum entry to a 24h pullback. PM proxy shorts remain dangerous when the source signal disagrees or spreads are wide; keep them shadow-gated. No parameter changes look supported yet.
